verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS IT-management platform, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The available evidence covers APIs, PowerShell bulk operations, automated onboarding workflows and managing agent identities; these are adjacent automation and directory features, not an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
